{{Otheruses|Kooroo}}
The '''Kooroo system''' was a theorized [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was believed to be the origin point of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Kooroo (species)|Kooroo]].<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that the Kooroo system was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was an imaginary location.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
